name: climate
title: Climate event and extremes profile
description: Media documenting drought, heat, flood, storm, or other climate-attributed events. Attribution context comes from contextJoins to reanalysis or index products, not from the photograph alone.
notes: A photo of a dry reservoir is evidence of a condition. A 30-year rainfall deficit is an ERA5 (or equivalent) join, stored separately.
Do not present a context join as proof of legal or scientific attribution unless the source dataset and method say so.
